settings.heading: Sound. Connection. Life.
settings.body: Founded in Texas in 2020, on a simple belief: whether it is the raw sound of nature or carefully crafted music, sound is the medium that connects our daily lives, our travels and the world around us.

settings.heading: Founded in Texas.
settings.body: Kaibo audio was born out of a simple desire to combine a passion for music and travel while staying present to what is going on around us. Our inaugural product, Kaibo Buds, was one of the first true bone-conduction headphones in an earbud style.
settings.image_alt: Kaibo Buds worn open-ear, the earbud sitting clear of the ear canal

settings.heading: Crowdfunded, over $700,000 raised.
settings.body: We launched our first crowdfunding campaign with Kaibo Flex, another first-of-its-kind bone-conduction device with a portable charging dock. The campaign raised over $700,000 and taught us lessons that made the company better and stronger. We remain grateful for the support the crowdfunding community showed us.
settings.image_alt: Kaibo Flex worn over the ear while driving

settings.heading: A growing collection, still open-ear.
settings.body: With a growing range of both premium and accessible bone-conduction headphones, we stayed committed to products that combine open-ear audio quality and unique features at a price people can reach.
settings.image_alt: An open-ear Kaibo headset worn outdoors

settings.heading: From one pair of earbuds to three ways of listening.
settings.body: Kaibo audio is built on the continuous research and application of bone-conduction technology: taking what the laboratory proves and folding it into something a person is willing to wear all day. The goal is to protect hearing rather than wear it down.

settings.title: TV Hearing Assistance
settings.body: Next-generation LE Audio and Auracast™ broadcast, so the television at home arrives low-latency and crystal clear without disturbing anyone else in the room.

settings.title: Tour Hearing Assistance
settings.body: Lightweight wireless open-ear headphones built for travel: guide commentary comes through clearly while the traveller stays naturally aware of their surroundings.

settings.title: Personal Hearing Assistance
settings.body: Professional sound-compensation algorithms, strong noise reduction and natural reproduction, for seamless listening protection through an ordinary day.

settings.heading: Three core listening experiences.
settings.body: Open, high-quality listening means something different in a living room, on a guided tour and across an ordinary day. Each of the three is built for its own situation rather than adapted from the others.

settings.title: Innovation
settings.body: Kaibo continuously pushes boundaries and introduces innovative solutions so that customers can make the best use of the technology available to them.

settings.title: Accessibility
settings.body: As technology progresses, so should accessibility. High-quality audio experiences should be available to everyone, not only to the people who can pay the most for them.

settings.title: Connection
settings.body: Kaibo strives for harmony between a personal listening experience and the life going on around it. With that connection, we can truly listen while life happens.

settings.heading: Innovation, accessibility, connection.
settings.body: We work with authenticity, humility and responsibility, and treat every Kaibo user with that same care. These three words are the ones we hold the products to.

settings.heading: Let's talk.
settings.body: Tell us which product you are looking at and we will come back with pricing, demo units and whatever else you need to get it in front of people.
